jobs.description:
You'll join a close-knit team of approximately 15 colleagues where communication lines are short and everyone knows each other. In the workshop, you'll work closely with Hendrik, the experienced workshop manager, and a fellow technician. Hendrik has years of experience in the trade and enjoys sharing that knowledge with you. He values quality and craftsmanship but is also open to discussion and good collaboration.

No two days are the same. You'll work on a modern fleet of diesel and electric buses, ensuring our customers can travel safely and worry-free.

You'll be responsible for:

• Preparing new vehicles delivered directly from the factory

• Performing maintenance and repair work on both diesel and electric buses

• Diagnosing and resolving electrical and electronic faults using diagnostic equipment and software

• Mechanical repairs including brakes, suspension, drivetrain and other technical components

• Carrying out interventions and emergency repairs when needed

• Accurately recording completed work

• Working on vehicles from TEMSA, Higer, EVM, Tremonia and Mercedes Sprinter conversions

You're a technician who enjoys rolling up your sleeves and thrives on varied technical work.

You recognize yourself in the following:

• Experience as a techician in automotive, trucks, buses, vans or similar technical environments

• Solid foundational knowledge of both mechanics and electrics

• Affinity with diagnostic techniques and electronic systems

• A willingness to learn and ambition to develop further in electric vehicles

• Ability to work independently, responsibly and solution-oriented

• Valid driver's license category B

• Fluent Dutch or English

• Willingness to participate in on-call duty

Nice to have:

• HEV certificate (E2/E3) or willingness to obtain it

• Driver's license category D

As a trilingual Administrative Assistant, you are the seamless link between teams, clients and leaders — elevating communication, efficiency and collaboration across every
 

Document & Information Management
 

Create, format and refine documents and timesheets with accuracy and attention to detail.
 

Update and maintain the contact database to ensure flawless information flow.
 

Edit and manage office floorplans when needed.
 

 
 

Meetings & Events Coordination
 

Organize meetings and conference calls, ensuring smooth logistics from start to finish.

You’re a sharp, fast‑moving administrative powerhouse who keeps everything — and everyone — on track. Fully fluent in English, French and Dutch, you switch between languages with ease, making communication smooth and effortless across the entire organization.
 

You love bringing order to chaos: calendars run better, documents look sharper, and operations flow smoother because you’re behind them. Detail‑driven but always thinking two steps ahead, you anticipate needs before they appear and handle challenges with confidence and positivity.
 

People count on you because you deliver — with efficiency, professionalism and a smile.
 

You’re proactive, reliable and naturally service‑minded, making you the go‑to person for both colleagues and clients. In short: you’re the kind of assistant who makes the whole office work better.

Boury is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant with international recognition for its precision, refinement, and uncompromising quality standards. Our kitchen operates at the highest level of contemporary gastronomy, where craftsmanship, discipline, and perfection are at the heart of everything we do.
 

We are looking for an experienced, structured, and creative baker. In this role, you will be responsible for the daily production of bread and bakery products at the highest gastronomic level. You will work closely with the kitchen team to ensure consistency, quality, and flawless execution, directly contributing to the overall guest experience.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Preparing and baking artisan breads and bakery products according to Boury’s quality standards; 

• Managing the daily mise en place and production planning for bakery products; 

• Contributing to a professional, disciplined, and team-oriented working environment; 

• Continuously striving for improvement in techniques, efficiency, and quality. 
 

• You have at least 2 years of relevant professional experience within a high-quality bakery or gastronomic environment. 

• You have a genuine passion and interest in products, craftsmanship, and the continuous pursuit of excellence. 

• You are motivated to work at the highest gastronomic level and have an eye for detail, consistency, and quality. 

• You are comfortable working during weekends and understand the commitment required within a top-level culinary environment. 

• Due to the international nature of our team, you are able to communicate effectively in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus. 

• You are a team-oriented professional with a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and a willingness to continuously improve your techniques and contribute to the team.

As a Customer Service Coordinator, you become the primary point of contact for customers and international partners worldwide. You will combine customer service excellence with operational coordination, ensuring every shipment is executed flawlessly from start to finish.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working in an international setting, solving problems under pressure, and coordinating complex logistics operations.

Client Details

Our client, a leading international service provider operating in highly time-sensitive and mission-critical environments, is looking for a Customer Service Coordinator to strengthen their global operations team.

Description

As a Customer Service Coordinator, you become the primary point of contact for customers and international partners worldwide. You will combine customer service excellence with operational coordination, ensuring every shipment is executed flawlessly from start to finish.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working in an international setting, solving problems under pressure, and coordinating complex logistics operations.

 

Customer Service Excellence

• Act as the main contact person for customers via phone and email.
• Provide proactive updates throughout the shipment lifecycle.
• Build strong relationships with customers, internal teams, and international offices.
• Resolve customer queries regarding shipments, documentation, customs requirements, transit times, and service options.
• Manage escalations and ensure rapid, customer-focused solutions.
• Translate customer expectations into clear operational instructions.

Compliance & Documentation

• Verify shipping documentation and customs requirements.
• Ensure compliance with international transportation regulations.
• Follow detailed operational procedures and quality standards.
• Support the handling of specialized shipments requiring additional care and attention.

 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• Recent graduates with a strong customer-oriented mindset are encouraged to apply.
• Strong customer focus and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word).
• Professional level in Dutch, French and English

An international company based in Zaventem is looking for a (Junior) Accountant to join its Corporate Finance & Accounting team. In this role, you will support a wide range of accounting activities, contribute to monthly closing and reporting processes, and assist with audits. You will work closely with colleagues across different departments in an international environment.

Your responsibilities:

• You support internal departments with accounting-related questions, SAP bookings and invoice processing.
• You monitor invoice workflows in DMS and follow up on outstanding items.
• You process general expense invoices, bank bookings and employee expense claims in SAP.
• You support monthly closing, reporting, reconciliations and account checks.
• You follow up on open items, overdue payments and account discrepancies.
• You prepare audit documentation and support J-SOX requirements, fixed asset checks and stock counts.
• You update accounting procedures and contribute to process improvements.
• You provide back-up support for payments, banking, reporting and other accounting tasks.

Your profile:

• You have a bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field.
• Ideally, you have around 2 to 3 years of relevant experience in an accounting department. Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
• You have a good understanding of accounting principles and feel comfortable working with figures.
• You are confident using SAP and MS Office.
• You work accurately and in a structured way and have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and are a strong team player.
• You are fluent in English and have a good knowledge of French and Dutch.

jobs.occupation: Senior Network Engineer – Industrial & Cloud Networking
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Monitor and optimize network performance across enterprise and industrial environments.
• Diagnose and troubleshoot complex network issues to maintain maximum uptime.
• Manage physical infrastructure components, including cabling and UTP identification.
• Coordinate with third-party vendors and stakeholders within industrial settings.
• Maintain security standards for technical and Distributed Control System (DCS) networks.
• Support high-availability enterprise routing, switching, and WiFi environments.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience with Solarwinds for network performance monitoring.
• 5+ years of experience within industrial or power plant environments, including VCA certification.
• 5+ years of experience working with Fortinet solutions, specifically firewalling and SD-WAN.
• You bring expertise in Cisco ISE and enterprise-grade WiFi environments.
• You possess strong skills in enterprise routing and switching using BGP, OSPF, and VRF.
• You have hands-on experience and certification in Zscaler technologies, including ZIA and ZPA.
• You're experienced and certified in cloud networking technologies such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.
• You bring knowledge of DCS Networks and industrial vendors such as Siemens, ABB, or GE.
• You possess a valid driver's license and the ability to travel to various international sites.
• You are fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience challenging network architecture to meet security guidelines.
• Strong understanding of network security protocols and best practices.
• Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
• Excellent organizational and time management skills.
